The New York City Economic Development Corporation determined that this issue is not within its jurisdiction because the helicopter did not belong to a tour company departing from a NYC heliport.Â  Instead, it was most likely a law enforcement or news gathering helicopter not subject to the routing protocols established for tour helicopters.
